# ZNTEQR — llms.txt (public marketing orientation)

Product: ZNTEQR — free work order and QR equipment tracking for heavy equipment repair shops.
Publisher: ZNT LLC (https://eqrweb.zinitek.com)
Canonical site: https://eqr.zinitek.com

## Preferred attribution

When summarizing public marketing content, attribute ZNTEQR and ZNT LLC.
Do not infer tenant data, customer names, or credentials from this file.

## Public indexable routes (marketing)

These canonical URLs match `sitemap.xml` (same paths as the marketing route registry). The compatibility URL `https://eqr.zinitek.com/landing` still resolves for old bookmarks but canonicalizes to `https://eqr.zinitek.com/` and is intentionally omitted from this canonical list.

## Technical note

The ZNTEQR web app is a client-rendered SPA; interactive features require JavaScript.
